<style>
  /* ==========================================
     PRODUCT CARD BADGES
     ========================================== */

  .emg-payment-badges {
    position: absolute;
    top: 10px;
    left: 10px;
    z-index: 30;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 5px;

    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .emg-payment-badge {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;

    height: 30px;
    min-width: 30px;

    padding: 4px 8px;

    border-radius: 4px;

    box-sizing: border-box;

    box-shadow:
      0 2px 5px rgba(0,0,0,.18);

    background: #ffffff;
  }

  .emg-payment-badge img {
    display: block;

    width: auto;
    max-width: 52px;
    height: 20px;

    object-fit: contain;
  }


  /* ==========================================
     PRODUCT PAGE BADGES
     ========================================== */

  .emg-product-payment-badges {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    gap: 8px;

    margin-top: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }

  .emg-product-payment-badges .emg-payment-badge {
    position: relative;

    height: 34px;

    padding: 5px 10px;

  .emg-product-payment-badges .emg-payment-badge img {
    max-width: 60px;

  }


  /* ==========================================
     MOBILE
     ========================================== */

  @media screen and (max-width: 749px) {

    .emg-payment-badges {
      top: 7px;
      left: 7px;
      gap: 4px;
    }

    .emg-payment-badge {
      height: 26px;
      min-width: 54px;
      padding: 3px 6px;
      border-radius: 4px;
    }

    .emg-payment-badge img {
      max-width: 46px;
      height: 17px;
    }

    .emg-product-payment-badges {
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 10px;
      margin-bottom: 10px;
    }

      height: 30px;
      min-width: 64px;

</style>


<script>
(function () {

  'use strict';


  /* =====================================================
     IMPORTANT:
     REPLACE THESE TWO URLs WITH YOUR SHOPIFY FILE URLs
     ===================================================== */

  const DEEMA_LOGO =
    'https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0675/2482/1146/files/deema-logo.png?v=1786361056';

  const TALY_LOGO =
    'https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0675/2482/1146/files/taly-logo.png?v=1786361056';


  /* =====================================================
     CREATE BADGE
     ===================================================== */

  function createBadge(type) {

    const badge = document.createElement('span');

    badge.className =
      'emg-payment-badge emg-' + type;

    const img = document.createElement('img');

    img.alt =
      type === 'deema'
        ? 'Pay later with Deema'
        : 'Split your payments with Taly';

    img.src =
      type === 'deema'
        ? DEEMA_LOGO
        : TALY_LOGO;

    badge.appendChild(img);

    return badge;
  }


  /* =====================================================
     CREATE PRODUCT CARD BADGES
     ===================================================== */

  function addProductCardBadges() {

    const cards = document.querySelectorAll(
      '.product-card,' +
      '.product-card-wrapper,' +
      '.card-wrapper,' +
      '.card--product,' +
      '.product-grid-item,' +
      '[class*="product-card"],' +
      '[class*="card-product"]'
    );


    cards.forEach(function(card) {

      /*
       * Prevent duplicates
       */
      if (
        card.querySelector(
          '.emg-payment-badges'
        )
      ) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Make sure this is a product card
       */
      const productLink =
        card.querySelector(
          'a[href*="/products/"]'
        );

      if (!productLink) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Find product image container
       */
      let media =
        card.querySelector(
          '.card__media,' +
          '.product-card__media,' +
          '.product-card__image,' +
          '.card-media,' +
          '.media,' +
          '.product-card__image-wrapper'
        );


      /*
       * Fallback to image parent
       */
      if (!media) {

        const image =
          card.querySelector('img');

        if (image) {
          media = image.parentElement;
        }
      }


      if (!media) {
        return;
      }


      /*
       * Make positioning relative
       */
      if (
        window.getComputedStyle(media).position
        === 'static'
      ) {

        media.style.position =
          'relative';
      }


      /*
       * Badge container
       */
      const container =
        document.createElement('div');

      container.className =
        'emg-payment-badges';


      /*
       * Deema
       */
      container.appendChild(
        createBadge('deema')
      );


      /*
       * Taly
       */
      container.appendChild(
        createBadge('taly')
      );


      media.appendChild(container);

    });
  }


  /* =====================================================
     PRODUCT PAGE BADGES
     ===================================================== */

  function addProductPageBadges() {

    /*
     * Only run on product pages
     */
    if (
      !document.body.classList.contains(
        'template-product'
      ) &&
      !window.location.pathname.includes(
        '/products/'
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }


    /*
     * Prevent duplicates
     */
    if (
      document.querySelector(
        '.emg-product-payment-badges'
      )
    ) {
      return;
    }


    /*
     * Find product information area
     */
    const productInfo =
      document.querySelector(
        'main-product,' +
        '.product__info-container,' +
        '.product-info,' +
        '.product__info,' +
        '[class*="product-info"]'
      );


    if (!productInfo) {
      return;
    }


    /*
     * Find price
     */
    const price =
      productInfo.querySelector(
        '.price,' +
        '.product__price,' +
        '[class*="price"]'
      );


    /*
     * Create badge container
     */
    const container =
      document.createElement('div');

    container.className =
      'emg-product-payment-badges';


    /*
     * Deema
     */
    container.appendChild(
      createBadge('deema')
    );


    /*
     * Taly
     */
    container.appendChild(
      createBadge('taly')
    );


    /*
     * Put badges directly after price
     */
    if (price) {

      price.parentNode.insertBefore(
        container,
        price.nextSibling
      );

    } else {

      productInfo.prepend(
        container
      );

    }

  }


  /* =====================================================
     RUN
     ===================================================== */

  function initPaymentBadges() {

    addProductCardBadges();

    addProductPageBadges();

  }


  /*
   * Initial load
   */

  if (
    document.readyState === 'loading'
  ) {

    document.addEventListener(
      'DOMContentLoaded',
      initPaymentBadges
    );

  } else {

    initPaymentBadges();

  }


  /*
   * Shopify section loading
   */

  document.addEventListener(
    'shopify:section:load',
    function () {

      setTimeout(
        initPaymentBadges,
        300
      );

    }
  );


  /*
   * AJAX / dynamic products
   */

  let observerTimer;

  const observer =
    new MutationObserver(
      function () {

        clearTimeout(
          observerTimer
        );

        observerTimer =
          setTimeout(
            initPaymentBadges,
            400
          );

      }
    );


  observer.observe(
    document.body,
    {
      childList: true,
      subtree: true
    }
  );

})();
</script>
